description: Implementation of MediaClock class managing media timing, synchronization, and timers within Android's stagefright media framework.

classes.name: MediaClock
classes.description: Handles media timing, synchronization, and timer notifications for media playback.

classes.name: MediaClock::Timer
classes.description: Represents a timer with notification, media time, and real-time adjustment parameters.

methods.name: MediaClock::init
methods.description: Registers the MediaClock handler with the looper.

methods.name: MediaClock::~MediaClock
methods.description: Destructor that resets the clock and stops the looper.

methods.name: MediaClock::reset
methods.description: Resets timers and anchor times, and updates internal state.

methods.name: MediaClock::clearAnchor
methods.description: Clears the anchor times, effectively resetting synchronization.

methods.name: MediaClock::updateAnchor
methods.description: Updates the media and real-time anchor points for synchronization.

methods.name: MediaClock::updateMaxTimeMedia
methods.description: Sets the maximum media time allowed.

methods.name: MediaClock::setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for media timing.

methods.name: MediaClock::getMediaTime
methods.description: Calculates media time for a given real time.

methods.name: MediaClock::getRealTimeFor
methods.description: Calculates real time for a given media time.

methods.name: MediaClock::addTimer
methods.description: Adds a timer that triggers a notification at a specified media time.

methods.name: MediaClock::processTimers_l
methods.description: Processes timers, posts notifications, and schedules next timer.

methods.name: MediaClock::updateAnchorTimesAndPlaybackRate_l
methods.description: Updates anchor times and playback rate, and notifies of discontinuity.

methods.name: MediaClock::setNotificationMessage
methods.description: Sets the message used for notifications.
